title: fix(verify): run a declared managed datasource on an ephemeral stand-in, never its real database
body:
Fixes #35523

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:应用作者在本地跑应用自检时,若某个对象绑在声明为"平台托管"的辅助数据源上,自检写的测试数据从此只落进自检自己的临时内存库,不再写进那个数据源指向的真实数据库;这些对象照样被检查。
- 为什么做:自检要求"测试数据只写进临时库",上一轮只管住了外部数据源,托管数据源这一半还在往真实库里写。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是某类托管库被误判,其对象在自检报告里显示为"未检查"而非被写入;这是一处纯自检工具改动,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

`os verify` builds every declared datasource through its own driver factory (`packages/verify/src/managed-datasource-stand-in.ts`), which wraps the one `objectstack dev` uses (`createDefaultDatasourceDriverFactory`):

- A declared datasource whose `resolveDatasourceSchemaMode(spec)` is `managed` (or that declares none) is built as a fresh in-memory store: a SQL engine (`sqlite`, `sqlite-wasm`, `postgres`, `mysql`, `turso`) gets the engine of verify's own default store (`sqlite-wasm` `:memory:`, or `memory` under `databaseDriver: 'memory'`), and a `memory` datasource gets a memory store with no persistence. The stand-in is built by the real factory from a spec of verify's own (name, engine, in-memory config), so nothing of the declared connection (url, credentials, pool, persistence) reaches it. This is the swap ruling A on #22301 already makes for `default`; the harness header now says it covers declared managed stores too.
- An external datasource keeps its real driver: reads reach it, and `deriveCrudCases` keeps writes off it (unchanged from #35509).
- A managed datasource whose engine has no faithful stand-in (`mongodb`, or a driver id the platform ships no contract for, i.e. a plugin's, which the factory never builds anyway) keeps its real driver, and `deriveCrudCases` withholds its objects from every write family: `managed datasource "NAME" (driver "DRIVER"): not exercised — verify has no ephemeral stand-in for this engine and never writes through to the real one`. A datasource named `default` is exempt: verify's own store holds that name.
- Cascade wording: a managed object that requires a withheld target (external, or the case above), directly or transitively, now reads `required relational target "X" is withheld on purpose — REASON` instead of `is not synthesizable`. A target blocked for a field shape keeps the generic sentence.
- `derive.ts` comment fixed: only the `schemaMode` half is the engine's write gate; the object's `external` block is verify's own trigger.
- Docs brought into line: `packages/verify/README.md`, the `harness.ts` header, and the `os verify` section of `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx`.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/verify`. No new flag, option or export (the module is not re-exported from `index.ts`).

## Tests

New `packages/verify/src/verify.managed-datasource-stand-in.test.ts`:

- Boot pin: a managed secondary datasource on a real, file-backed `sqlite-wasm` database (the file is the recording driver). After CRUD, reference shapes, delete behaviours, unique scopes and a REST create, the real database file was never created (`{ exists: false, rows: 0 }`).
- Coverage kept: the bound object's CRUD case is `verified` against the stand-in; the REST create answers 201 and reads back 200.
- CONTROL: the factory `objectstack dev` uses (`createDefaultDatasourceDriverFactory`), given the same declaration, opens that file and writes a row into it.
- Factory unit pins against a recording real factory: managed postgres and mode-less sqlite become `sqlite-wasm` `:memory:` (secret and host dropped); managed memory loses its persistence; external and managed mongodb pass through unchanged.

`derive.test.ts`: withheld-on-purpose cascade wording (direct and transitive), the generic sentence kept for a field-shape block, and managed postgres exercised vs mongodb / plugin driver withheld.

<details><summary>Red on origin/main, green on head, one ablation</summary>

- Red on `origin/main` (`harness.ts` + `derive.ts` restored from d2bc1ffd, tree only; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, `git diff HEAD` empty): `× nothing reached the real database` with `+ "exists": true, + "rows": 11`; Tests 1 failed / 8 passed; lock VERDICT command-exit 1.
- Green on head 2de0d505: `vitest run src/verify.managed-datasource-stand-in.test.ts src/derive.test.ts` → Test Files 2 passed, Tests 40 passed; VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `driverFactory: createVerifyDatasourceDriverFactory({` x1 → x0, blob fd6fa6de → dfceaaa6): the same pin red with `"rows": 11`; restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. No dist leg: the suite imports the harness from `src/`.
- Full package: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` → Test Files 55 passed, Tests 475 passed (head 2de0d505). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify typecheck` exit 0.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- A managed `mongodb` datasource (and a plugin-driver one) keeps its real driver, so the app's own seed and hooks still reach it during `os verify`, as for an external datasource; only verify's derived writes are withheld from it. Route A scopes the change to verify's own writes.
- The control does not boot `os dev`; it builds the declared datasource through the same factory `os dev` composes and writes the real file, which is what proves the boot pin's silence is the stand-in.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/verify/src/managed-datasource-stand-in.ts` (`create`: the managed / stand-in decision), `packages/verify/src/derive.ts` (the new withheld branch and the Pass 2 cascade), `packages/verify/src/harness.ts` (the factory wiring).

Two-minute check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/verify exec vitest run src/verify.managed-datasource-stand-in.test.ts` shows 9 passed; on `origin/main`'s `harness.ts` it shows the real database file with 11 rows.

<details><summary>Derived gates (dispatch-gates --commands at 2de0d505, 104 families)</summary>

All 104 derived families ran locally at head 2de0d505, each exit 0 (exit codes captured before any pipe). `dispatch-gates --ran`: 104 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 104 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: all 104 recorded an exit code). `check:skill-examples` and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered exit 3 (prerequisite: unbuilt dist) and were re-run after the workspace build `check:type-check-debt` performs: both exit 0. CI-only families (dogfood shards, Dogfood Verify CLI, Build Core, the type-check lanes) are left to CI.

</details>
